The market value is the closing price of the stock on September 30, 2026, the last business day of the quarter, as reported by the New York Stock Exchange. || Includes 471 unvested restricted stock units of Farmer Mac's Class C Non-Voting Common Stock that will vest on March 31, 2027, if the Reporting Person remains a director of Farmer Mac on that
date.
